sources.title: FACE SPOOFING DETECTION TECHNOLOGY USING DEEP LEARNING - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Strong countermeasures are more important as these spoofing techniques get more complex. The main goal of this project is to use deep learning techniques to create a reliable and efficient face spoofing detection system. Among the specific goals are: • Investigating the state-of-the-art in face spoofing attacks and their growing complexity.

sources.title: MS-MFAD : Multimodal large language models for Face Anti-spoofing Detection
sources.snippet: Facial biometric recognition systems currently face compound threats intertwining generative AI and high-fidelity physical spoofing. Existing defenses suffer from systemic bottlenecks, including poor generalization, non-auditable reasoning, and reliance on massive, low-quality datasets. To address these challenges, we propose Multimodal Large Language Models (MFAD) for face anti-spoofing ...

sources.title: How Fake AI Selfies Bypass Identity Verification
sources.snippet: This article explores how AI-generated faces bypass identity verification, where conventional checks fall short, and what a stronger detection architecture now requires.
